title: Gauge-Fixing the Forward-Forward Objective: A Whitened Goodness Derived from a Likelihood-Ratio Account
abstract: arXiv:2607.12501v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The Forward-Forward algorithm trains each layer locally, so that a scalar goodness - the sum of squared activations - is high on real inputs and low on contrastive ones. Under an explicit generative model this goodness is the sufficient statistic of a likelihood-ratio test, and the pairwise form of the objective admits a gauge: a layer can lower its loss by inflating the scale of its weights rather than by separating the two populations. The analysis prescribes the repair - a whitened, scale-invariant goodness trained online within each layer - which we evaluate as a training procedure. Across three corpora, three depths and a fourfold range of layer width (13 seeds per cell), it raises linear-probe accuracy over the standard pairwise objective in every measured cell - by 4 to 7 points on eight of nine corpus-depth combinations - and closes 16-61% of the gap to end-to-end backpropagation. translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.12501v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：前向-前向算法逐层局部训练，使得标量优度（即激活值的平方和）在真实输入上较高，而在对比输入上较低。在显式生成模型下，该优度是似然比检验的充分统计量，且目标的成对形式存在一种规范自由度：层可以通过扩大权重尺度而非分离两类分布来降低损失。该分析规定了修复方法——一种在每层内在线训练的白化、尺度不变优度——我们将其作为训练过程进行评估。在三个语料库、三种深度和四倍层宽范围（每个单元格13个种子）中，它在线性探针精度上超过了所有测量单元格中的标准成对目标——在九个语料库-深度组合中的八个上提高了4到7个百分点——并弥合了与端到端反向传播差距的16-61%。一个对照实验隔离了机制：Hinton的fi
tldr: 本文通过似然比视角揭示了前向-前向算法中优度目标因权重尺度膨胀而失效的规范问题，并提出一种白化、尺度不变的在线训练优度，在多个基准上显著提升线性探针精度并缩小与反向传播的差距。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals a gauge issue in the Forward-Forward objective where weight scale inflation can degrade goodness, and proposes a whitened, scale-invariant online training goodness that consistently improves linear-probe accuracy and reduces the gap to backpropagation across benchmarks.
